projects.title: Projects
projects.intro: A selection of my most relevant projects, showcasing my expertise in development and data analysis.

1.title: Quant Notebooks
1.description: Repository dedicated to learning Marimo and quantitative financial data analysis. Includes studies on trading strategies, macroeconomic analysis, and technical indicators using Python and financial libraries.

2.title: Second Brain
2.description: Public curation of courses, Python libraries, data sources, papers and books on quantitative finance and data science, awesome-list style. Its own page with search, category and status filters, a beginner path and a bookshelf, updated daily from the repository.

3.title: Monitor B3
3.description: n8n-style visual tool to build market-signal screens for B3 assets: blocks for universe (stocks, units, BDRs, ETFs and FIIs), filters and 9 signals, such as 52-week highs/lows, SMA 50/200 crossovers, RSI 14, unusual volume and relative strength vs. Ibovespa/IFIX, with a live execution animation. Data refreshed every ~30 min via GitHub Actions, zero cost, educational only.

4.title: RRG · Relative Rotation
4.description: Interactive Relative Rotation Graph (RRG) with real data since 2018: Brazilian sectors, stocks and REITs, US stocks and sectors, countries, asset classes, factors, commodities and currencies, each group against its benchmark. Animated trails, a timeline with historical moments, “what changed this week”, per-asset detail and free mode. B3 and Yahoo Finance data refreshed daily via GitHub Actions, zero cost, educational only.

5.title: Market Regimes (HMM)
5.description: Hidden Markov Model that estimates, day by day, whether the Ibovespa and the S&P 500 are in a calm, intermediate or stress regime, using real data since 2000. Regime-colored price, filtered probabilities (no look-ahead) over time, transition matrix, duration and per-regime stats, 2 or 3 states, daily or weekly frequency and historical moments for each market. Model refitted daily via GitHub Actions, zero cost, educational only.

6.title: Pairs Trading
6.description: Relative value between pairs of assets, with tests against spurious correlation: only economically linked pairs, cointegration via Engle-Granger (both directions) and Johansen, multiple-testing correction with FDR (Benjamini-Hochberg), mean-reversion half-life between 2 and 60 days, rolling-window stability and an out-of-sample walk-forward backtest with costs. Pairs are split into robust and candidate tiers, with spread, z-score and entry/exit bands. Yahoo Finance data refreshed via GitHub Actions, zero cost, educational only.
